question: Does six-major downside breadth and acceleration warn of collective severe declines earlier or with less noise than BTC alone?
scope: Alarm evaluation only; no orders, trade outcomes, strategy parameters, training, services or live changes.

event.definition: At current minute i, low_i / close_(i-5) - 1 for each coin; NOT a rolling minimum. Median <= -3% and at least4of6 <= -2%.
event.clock: First flagged minute open is the conservative earliest severe-threshold crossing; labels become known after minute close. It is not the initial selloff onset.
event.recovery: Descriptive only: median normalized close basket; trough in first30m after crossing, recovery of at least half that drawdown at60m. Does not filter event admission.

score.definition: r=log(close/previous_close); sigma=std of1440previous returns, excluding current. Percoin=(clip(-r/sigma,0,20)+clip((previous_r-r)/sigma,0,20))/2. Score=median(percoin)*share(r<0). BTC uses the same equation with one coin.
score.availability: Minute open+60seconds+assumed feed/compute delay; no tick-reaction claims.

alarm.threshold_calibration: 32 bisection steps on development score only to match total alert count, no event labels; closest achieved count, higher threshold breaks tie. Greedy earliest eligible exceedance, same cooldown for both methods.
alarm.matching: One alarm to one event; earliest timely alarm per event. All other alarms remain in precision denominator, with late/inside versus ordinary false alarms separately. No future event suppression.

statistics.null: Same number of alarms per UTCweek x UTChour x laggedBTCvolatility quintile. Quintile boundaries from development only. Sample without replacement with the same15m separation. Keep event-period candidates. Failed exact-constraint replicates reported, never relax strata/cooldown. Use independent within-week rejection first, followed by global cross-week cooldown rejection; repeat whole blocked draw if cross-week constraints fail. Each rejection stage allows one initial attempt plus max_restarts.
statistics.pairing: Same event list and UTCweek blocks for paired recall and non-timely-alert/day differences; all coins from a shock are one event.
statistics.ranking_metrics: Minute ROC-AUC/AP against the next60..300second severe-crossing label are diagnostics, not iid significance tests or profit metrics.
statistics.interpretation: Historical chronological comparison;2026andothermarketepisodes have previously been observed. Do not call it untouched prospective validation. Require cross-year consistency and uncertainty bounds; no automatic promotion.

not_applicable: No strategy PnL, cost, win-rate or random-entry-return claim: this is a warning-system test. Conditional random alert times are its null control.
